checks.foreign: FARA: the bulk FARA files (all registrants, short-form registrants, foreign principals) were searched by exact name on 2026-10-13 by the records collector and re-checked here; the loose name matches in that output are other people, and nothing matches this candidate. 2026 House candidate report: no foreign-government ties; one foreign-company holding (spouse's Argo Blockchain PLC stock, $15K–$50K). Disclosures: read the filed PDF from the House Clerk (local copy pulled 2026-10-13). Net worth = sum of asset ranges minus sum of liability ranges as filed; a personal residence is not a reportable asset, so a mortgage on it pushes the range down.

note.t: 2026 candidate report (filed June 30, 2026; covers Jan. 1, 2025–Mar. 20, 2026). By far the wealthiest filer in this group: assets of $47.8M–$192.3M against liabilities of $19.0M–$65.2M (the range is very wide because many items sit in open-ended $1M–$5M and $5M–$25M bands). Holdings are dominated by about 60 commercial real-estate interests held jointly or by her spouse through 'AH', 'CGP' and 'HC' LLCs — shopping centers in Boaz and Jefferson County (Palisades; $5M–$25M each), a Harbor Freight site in Fultondale ($5M–$25M), and single-tenant retail and restaurant sites across Alabama plus Georgia, Tennessee, Texas, Kentucky and Florida — with 38 commercial real-estate mortgages, four business credit lines, and mortgages on her home and a lake house from Alabama and Mississippi banks. Also: legacy-trust money-market accounts and a Metro Bank CD ($1M–$5M), her spouse's Merrill Lynch SEP IRA ($500K–$1M) and Coinbase crypto ($250K–$500K), bank stocks (CommerceOne, Bank of Missouri, MC Bancshares), OS1 urgent-care stock, children's 529 plans and I-bonds, and her Alabama RSA and University of Alabama retirement accounts. Earned income listed is real-estate commissions and sales proceeds from Capital Growth Real Estate and CGP entities (about $280K in the 2026 period). Positions: board member of Unless U, Inc.; resigned from Hub in the Hills, Inc. board (June 2026). Only foreign item: her spouse's Argo Blockchain PLC stock (UK-listed, $15K–$50K). Candidate reports have no transaction schedule.

research_notes: Courts 'news' rests on two news searches that surfaced only campaign coverage. With about 60 LLC real-estate interests, Alacourt/federal dockets for the LLCs (not just her name) would be the thorough check — not possible here. Democracy stays 'news'.
